description: This file is an HTML document that embeds a CodeMirror editor instance configured to display and edit Puppet scripting code, with a focus on the Puppet class 'automysqlbackup'. It includes HTML markup, CSS styles, embedded JavaScript, and a significant block of Puppet code within a textarea.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes the CodeMirror editor instance on the textarea element with ID 'code', configuring it for Puppet language mode, bracket matching, and indentation.
